final: SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk FROM (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.location ORDER BY AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.location) <> '' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location) WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk, event_id
